msContents.summary: This copy of the Vedāṅkuśa, attributed to Hemacandra, seems to be the first edition, published in 1918. A second edition was published in 1923; for more information, see Wezler 1993, where the title of the text is rendered as A slap on the face of Brahmins.

listBibl.bibl: Wezler, Albrecht. 1993. ‘A slap on the face of Brahmins’. Introducing a Little-Known Jain Text of Polemical Objectives. In Jain Studies in Honour of Jozeph Deleu, edited by Rudy Smet & Kenji Watanabe. Tokyo: Hon-no-tomosha. 485–501.

lg.l: yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman! bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgatam |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt_ tan me brūhi tapodhana! || 106 ||
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇām |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam || 107 ||
idam eva purā devas tulayā samatolayan |
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate || 108 ||
jaṅgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |
ātmavat_ parirakṣanti te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 109 ||
sarvasattveṣu yad dānam ekasattve ca yā dayā |
sarvasattvapradānāc ca dayaikāsmin_ viśiṣyate || 110 ||
catuḥsāgaraparyantāṃ yo dadyāt_ pṛthivīm imām |
abhayaṃ yas tu bhūtebhyas tayor abhayado 'dhikaḥ || 111 ||
sarve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca bhārata! |
sarve tīrthābhiṣekāś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā || 112 ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā |
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 113 ||
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ yaḥ svaśaktiṃ samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 114 ||
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajet śaraṇāgatam |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 115 ||
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahantavye na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit || 116 ||
yūkāmatkuṇadaṃśādīn_ ye jantūṃs tudatas tanum |
putravat parirakṣanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 117 ||
vane vanadṛṇāhārā prāṇino 'naparādhinaḥ |
hantum icchati yo dīnān_ taṃ vidyāt brahmaghātakam || 118 ||
govraje vā vane cāpi grāme vā nagare 'pi vā |
yo 'gniṃ samutsṛjet mūḍhas taṃ vidyāt_ brahmaghātakam ||| 119 ||
ātmā viṣṇuḥ samastānāṃ vāsudevo jagatpatiḥ |
tasmān na vaiṣṇavaiḥ kāryā parihiṃsā viśeṣataḥ || 120 ||
